items.title: Bitcoin falls to $83,000 while altcoins unwind Friday's rally
items.summary: Bitcoin fell 1.7% to $83,000, though the CoinDesk 100 dropped 2.6% as Friday's biggest gainers reversed and oil climbed back above $100.

items.title: Live updates: Bitcoin sinks below $83,000 as Iran talks stall and oil climbs
items.summary: ZEC led losses among major tokens as Brent pushed toward $108 and traders added to bets on another Fed rate increase ahead of this week's inflation and jobs data.

items.title: Bitcoin bears pay to bet on further declines as futures positions near yearly lows
items.summary: Overall demand for leveraged exposure remains weak, marked by sliding futures open interest. The capital that's still in the market appears skewed toward bearish positions.

items.title: RedotPay completes financial audit as it presses ahead with U.S. IPO plans
items.summary: The stablecoin payments company said the audit is part of its preparations to go public, disputing an August report that the listing had been put on hold.
